function.name: GET_PARCEL_STATE
function.description: Determines the current state of a parcel based on its tracking ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: GET_COMPLAINT_STATE
function.description: Retrieves the current state of a user's complaint using the complaint tracking ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

userMobileNumber.description: The mobile number of the user, formatted as a string without spaces or special characters (e.g., '1234567890').

complaintTrackingId.description: A unique identifier for the complaint, used to track the status of the complaint.

function.name: handover_to_agent
function.description: This function initiates a handover process to transfer the ongoing chat session from a virtual assistant to a human agent. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the human agent to whom the chat will be transferred.

session_id.description: The session identifier of the current chat that needs to be handed over.

priority.description: The priority level for the handover request.

message.description: An optional message from the virtual assistant to the human agent.
